fields.statement: The model app takes an optional [<ref>] (`rhiza tui app model [<ref>]`) that limits the tree to the subtree under that node, as `rhiza tree <ref>` does. model-tree-app's 50 ms budget covers the app's read of a deep subtree plus the roadmap, the tree read that t7-d14-read-budget budgets; with no ref the app reads the whole as-is tree, which is outside the budget, as a whole-tree `rhiza tree` is.
fields.wording: fixer of review cycle 2 on leaf model-tree-app, recording the reading of the budget the build and its evidence used (model f1)
